title: XW-ENC-AFFINITY-1 (apex-mf6) L2 live: untagged-target-row optimistic retention. The case config_patch empties the TERRA row's x-litellm-tags (sol row untouched), seeds the ACP session with the byte-pinned canonical sol-phase history (cell az-az-unpin: 10 records, 2 reasoning rides id=encitem_* + encrypted_content + summary text, NO mint_tag = untagged provenance), switches gpt-5.6-sol -> gpt-5.6-terra MID-SESSION (ACP session/set_model, same-family (codex,codex) -> no wall, no lossy compact), then one post-switch turn. PREDICTED (design xw-enc-affinity-design-20260919.md 3.2/3.4 + in-tree gate conversation.rs enc_affinity_gate): switch-time projection target_pin=None, every ride mint_tag=None -> (None,None) = RetainOptimistic -> storage T0 (cell expected.json byte-identical to pre_switch, scored at switch time); SEND-TIME gate on the first terra request pin absent + mint absent = RetainOptimistic -> the seeded encrypted_content CROSSES the terra wire (the mf6 behavioral delta: the retired D-ENC stripped unconditionally at every /responses send). LIVE VERDICT BAND (design 5: a live mismatch is a lottery - do not gate on it): 200 on attempt 1 = LB converged on the same boundary (count 1); 503 (encryption-boundary ServiceUnavailableError) -> the NEW reactive fallback (SIG-ENC-BOUNDARY class, bulk-strip + exactly one retry) -> 200 (count 2). ANY outcome outside the band (count >2, non-200 FINAL, second same-class failure after strip, wire-shape change = new field on a reasoning item) = defect beyond the documented surface -> report-and-stop. Suite is cross-wire (the committed schema has no enc-affinity suite; the affinity semantics live in the pins).

wire.label: L2 RETAIN-OPTIMISTIC WIRE FORM: the seeded untagged ride (mint_tag absent) crossed the untagged terra request WITH encrypted_content — pin absent + mint absent = RetainOptimistic (design 3.2). Absent = a D-ENC-style unconditional strip (pre-mf6 behavior) or a gate misclassification of the (None,None) arm -> report-and-stop (the fallback arm is asserted hermetically by the classifier unit tests; the wire form here is the optimistic arm's pin).

VERDICT BAND (design 5: a live mismatch is a lottery): 1 = 200 on attempt 1 (LB converged on the same encryption boundary — warm-deployment convergence, MUST NOT be re-pinned to 1, design 6); 2 = 503 boundary error -> reactive bulk-strip fallback -> 200 (the NEW SIG-ENC-BOUNDARY retry arm doing its job). >2 = fallback loop or storm (the counter is max-1/request by construction) -> report-and-stop; 0 = the turn never fired -> report-and-stop.

FINAL ACCEPTED: the FINAL terra request in scope reached 200 (converged boundary on attempt 1, or the post-fallback-strip attempt 2). A non-200 final = brick / unclassified wire-error shape -> report-and-stop (house rule: a new shape is a finding, not a retry).
